{{Quote|All fighters, all squadrons, this is Flight Commander Drolan, Dee Ess One One. We are deploying in Zone Defense Delta, I say again, Zee-Dee-Delta. We are about to get our feet wet, boys, and I'm buying for the pilot who shoots the most of the fatherless scum out of the vac.|Flight Commander [[Drolan]]|<ref name="DS" />}}
'''Flight Commander''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] in use by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="CRO" /> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="DV">{{WEGCite|story=Dark Voyage to Tatooine|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref> during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Margo Flarestream|Margo "Pepper" Flarestream]] held this rank during the [[Last Stand at Refnar]],<ref name="CRO" /> as did Imperial pilot [[Mallop]].<ref name="DV" />
